L1 PERCEPT (fixed-point; one C99 lib, three call sites; norm.h frozen)
ring buffers to EWMA / CUSUM / run-length histograms
S1..S10 passive discriminative stats to feature vector
plus CUSUM anomaly gate

L2 AGENT (~1 Hz)
classifier to belief (8 + unknown)
test planner (expected info-gain per cost)
policy head (validated lookup + learned corrections)

SAFETY ENVELOPE
logit masking, then monotone escalation ladder, then dead-man failsafe.c
(runs even if inference hangs)
